frame_metadata.parameterization: Spline parameter u is original polyline physical arc fraction; arc-length resampling does not redefine u
frame_metadata.smoothing_semantics: RMS 3D residual budget at supplied controls; FITPACK s=n*smoothing_mm^2; no per-point displacement guarantee
frame_metadata.sampling_semantics: Uniform fitted-spline arc distance from bounded dense trapezoidal speed quadrature and monotone linear inversion
frame_metadata.frame_semantics: T follows supplied order; N follows principal curvature toward inner bend; B=T cross N; outer=-N
frame_metadata.reliability_semantics: Inner/outer valid only where reliable: sufficient curvature and no endpoint, stationary tangent, or sampled normal-turn ambiguity
frame_metadata.transport_semantics: Minimum-rotation reference normals are display-only in low curvature; never substitute them for valid inner/outer directions
frame_metadata.stationary_tangent_semantics: Nearest valid fitted tangent is display-only fallback; if all samples are stationary, original parent-segment direction is used
frame_metadata.inflection_semantics: Opposing transported principal normals flag an inflection or unresolved normal-turn candidate; true Frenet normals are not flipped
frame_metadata.endpoint_policy: First and last fitted samples excluded from reliable inner/outer semantics
